raw_response:
I have some schooling so I understand that fertilizer helps, but money is tight with only 0.11 hectares of maize here. I will put a small amount of DAP and urea on this plot because the soil in Iringa can give good maize if fed, and I have cow manure that I will also spread. I plant an improved variety because it grows better than the local one, but I will weed with my family by hand since the plot is small and chemicals cost too much. We rely on the rains and our own sweat, though I might hire a neighbor for a couple of days when harvest comes quickly.
